title: NPC
description: One non-player character. DERIVED from the authored valley/npcs corpus (SNG-BATCH-9 build-step-1) so generate('npc', ctx) can validate its output against the same shape the hand-authored people have. `required` is the load-bearing core every authored single-NPC carries; the fuller set below (wants/knowledge/voiceHints/personality/homeLocation/communityId/reactsToReputation) is what a WELL-FORMED npc should have — the generator is prompted for all of it and generate()'s repair step fills any the model omits from context defaults. The legends registry (npcs/legends.json) is NOT a single NPC and is excluded from this schema.

id.description: stable slug; for generated NPCs minted via the SNG-019 resolver (resolve-before-mint)

role.description: one-line who-they-are + what-they-do, in-grain for their locale

spectrum.description: disposition fingerprint: axisId -> [-1,1]. Known axes: body_mind, mechanical_spiritual, emotional_logical, concrete_abstract, falsehood_truth, dark_light, space_time, chaos_order, individual_collective, death_life, violence_peace, destruction_creation, tradition_innovation, demonic_angelic. Generated in-grain from the locale's poleIntensity.

poleIntensity.description: optional single-ended intensities (pole -> 0..1), derivable from spectrum by SNG-022

voiceHints.description: how they talk + a tell; the taste-carrier for in-character voice

knowledge.description: what they know that a player could learn

wants.description: the active desire that makes them move; a generated NPC gets one at birth (SNG-021 world-tick advances it). A richly-authored legendary NPC (SNG-132) may carry an ARRAY of layered wants.

fears.description: what they fear; a string, or an array of layered fears for a richly-authored NPC

reactsToReputation.description: reputationTag -> how they respond to a character carrying it; or `true` when a legendary NPC (SNG-132) reacts to reputation via its own GM notes rather than a tag map

universalRole.description: loose worldwide role (mediator/warrior/warden/keeper/maker/seeker/healer/...) whose METHOD comes from locale+disposition (universal_roles.json)

roleMethod.description: how this locale's grain bends the universal role

gender.description: SNG-143: explicit sex/gender — inclusive free string (woman|man|nonbinary|…); read by the portrait seed + narration so it is never inferred at render

pronouns.description: SNG-143: she/her, he/him, they/them — what narration uses

rating.description: content-rating tag (G/PG/PG-13/R/R+) stamped at generation to the requesting player's ceiling (SNG-BATCH-9 Phase 1 §3); absent on authored core (treated as world-default)

isMinor.description: true if a child/adolescent. FLOOR: a minor NPC is NEVER eligible for romantic/sexual content at any rating tier for any player (birth-validator, absolute).

level.description: ⚑ The authored level. A FLOOR, never a ceiling (SPEC_progressive_sheets): growth adds above it and must never prune below it.

subAttributes.description: strength · agility · reason · insight · presence · rapport · craft · wits. ⚠️ Read by the death save (higher of strength/presence) and by battleSkillsFor.

abilities.description: ⛔ THE SHEET. Crafts by id at an owned rank. R36: a party member fights from this. An authored list WINS over the derived kit and is a floor, not a cap.

assistTags.description: ⛔ Without these `contributionsOf` defaults everyone to HARM — a master smith counts as a striker. Read at band AND party scale.

domains.description: ⚑ `{primary, secondary, tertiary}` — R25's STANDING structure, and what `kitFor` draws from. ⚠️ 41 of 43 are objects; the two arrays are Pell and Veth, authored by Aevi in the wrong shape and owed a fix.

sex.description: ⛔ R24: set at generation, documented at first materialisation. Gates romance. `null` = undiscovered or genuinely neither.

romanceEligible.description: ⚠️ An explicit decision, never an omission. R24: opposite-sex only; a teacher or a minor is false BY AUTHORING.

physicality.description: ⛔ ADULTS ONLY (po/CONTENT_POLICY_physicality.md). How they are in a body — a GM needs this to describe someone in a fight, at a forge, wet from a river.

intimacyNotes.description: ⛔ ADULTS ONLY. What intimacy must NOT resolve; consent in their own voice.

gear.description: ⚠️ PROSE UNTIL THE BEARER RECORD CARRIES IT. The live object is `npcRegistry[id].inventory` (R45c, `ensureBearer`) — this is authoring intent, not state.

inventory.description: ⚑ R45c BEARER RECORD — what this person is actually holding. Written by `giveItemTo`/`takeItemFrom`, never authored by hand.

practice.description: ⚑ R45c — `{schemaVersion, uses, coActivations, coUse}`. Feeds item evolution and R39's rank evolution. ⛔ Engine-written.

closed.description: ⬜ Crafts this person will NOT learn, with a reason. ⚠️ For a stated judgement (Veth refuses `calling_back`), NEVER for a gap in what got authored — a data gap is not a personality.

people.description: ⚠️ THE SPECIES, not a relationship list — 'human', 'rootkin', 'ent'. ⛔ Aevi read the field NAME and declared an array; 43 of 43 carry a string.

teaches.description: ⚑ R33 `learnedAt`'s other end. ⚠️ 22 carry a STRING (prose: 'the attending craft, to those who ask properly'); an array of craft ids is the machine-readable form and both are accepted.

canStrike.description: ⚠️ PER-CHARACTER and narrow: 'adds no damage in the fold'. ⛔ Does NOT stop a GM running a scene with them.

questSeeds.description: ⚑ SNG-167 §2 — AN ERRAND THIS PERSON WOULD ACTUALLY ASK FOR, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears`. ⛔ 'A LOCATION can start an arc and a PERSON cannot… that is backwards: the memorable arcs start with SOMEONE, not somewhere.' ⚠️ Read by `npcQuestSeedBlock` and offered to the GM under rule 10b when that person is present. ⛔ NOT a hook the world hands them — R49's shape one layer down: a seed that names no objective is a nebulous hook. ⬜ Absent is fine; the `want` is the derived fallback, and 41 of 48 still rely on it.

_schemaGap_20260905: ⛔ THE SCHEMA DECLARED 25 PROPERTIES AND KNEW ABOUT NONE OF THE WORK OF THE LAST TWO WEEKS. Added 22: level, subAttributes, abilities, assistTags, domains, sex, romanceEligible, physicality, intimacyNotes, gear, inventory, practice, closed, people, teaches, canStrike, status, statusNote, image, aliases, bondType, bondStage. ⚠️ BOTH AUTHORED SHEETS (Pell, Veth) CARRIED TEN UNDECLARED FIELDS INCLUDING `abilities` — the sheet itself. ⛔ `additionalProperties` is unset, so JSON Schema defaults PERMISSIVE and nothing ever failed: THE VALIDATOR HAS NEVER CHECKED A SINGLE FIELD THAT MATTERS FOR COMBAT. Pell could have carried `abilties: []` and passed. ⬜ DELIBERATELY STILL PERMISSIVE — closing it would red-line 43 existing files at once. ⚠️ The value here is that a typo in `abilityId` or a rank of 5 now FAILS, and that the fields are DOCUMENTED where an author will look. ⚑ ASKED BY ERIK 2026-09-05: 'make sure the sheet schemas are sufficient for all the new updates we just made to holds, etc.' They were not.
_typesCorrected_20260905: ⛔ AEVI'S FIRST PASS DECLARED TYPES FROM THE FIELD NAMES RATHER THAN FROM THE FILES, AND RED-LINED ALL 43 NPCs. `people` is the SPECIES ('human'), not relationships. `domains` is `{primary, secondary, tertiary}` — R25's standing structure — not a list. `teaches` is prose in 22 files. ⚠️ MEASURED AND CORRECTED. ⛔ The same failure the whole project keeps finding: SHE READ THE NAME AND INFERRED THE SHAPE. ✅ The one real finding stands — the schema knew nothing about `abilities`, `assistTags`, `sex`, `physicality` or the R45c bearer record.
